method: FeetechMotorsBus.connect + broadcast_ping + sync_read(Present_Position, normalize=False) + read(Torque_Enable); no writes, disconnect(disable_torque=False)

arms.role: verified follower (old ACT log + my_robot calibration)

limitations: Motor IDs/positions prove four buses respond; they do not prove follower/leader or left/right roles. No motor writes, no torque changes.
